basic_info.description: A true fixer-upper, it's the perfect canvas for visionaries ready to restore or reimagine.  Wake up to the sound of waves and endless ocean views at 2578 Great Highway, a rare Victorian gem perched on San Francisco's iconic coastline. This home is brimming with charm, character  and yes, potential.  Featuring Victorian details, high ceilings, and an unbeatable location across from Ocean Beach with utility lines underground, this is a golden opportunity to craft your dream home in one of SF's most laid-back, surf-loving neighborhoods. Whether you're an investor, a contractor, or a romantic with a hammer, bring your tools and your imagination. Ocean views, classic Victorian facade, tremendous upside potential.  Conventional financing will likely not work.
